label: Customers
description: Billing customers for accounts receivable.

label: Invoices
description: Draft and issued AR invoices for the tenant.

label: Credit exposure
description: Every active customer account with its credit limit, exposure, available credit and risk — highest utilisation first.

label: Credit holds
description: Active credit holds across the tenant — triage and release with maker-checker.

label: Credit gauge
description: Live credit decision surface: limit, exposure, available and decision per customer position.

label: AR/AP netting
description: Net receivable and payable positions per partner for settlement planning.

label: Partners
description: Customers, vendors and employees as one counterparty.

label: Chart of accounts
description: The accounts journals post to, by book.

label: Books
description: The books your organization keeps its ledger in.

label: Journal entry
description: Draft a journal, add its lines and submit it; a second person approves and posts it.

label: Posted journals
description: The journals in the ledger, with their lines; reverse a posted one.

label: Periods
description: Open, soft-close and lock the periods journals post to.

label: Standard costs
description: Per-product standard unit costs used when posting inventory receipts.

label: Absence types
description: The kinds of absence people can ask for, and whether each is paid and needs a decision.

label: Absence requests
description: Everyone's absences, requests waiting for a decision first. Nobody decides their own.

label: Bookings
description: Who is booked on which work, when and where. Bookings are made and moved on Scheduling & dispatch.

label: Site calendars
description: The workspace calendar and one per site; their closures take working time away.

label: Closures
description: Days a calendar closes; nobody on it is available then.

label: My absences
description: Your own absences: ask for time off and follow the decision. Someone else decides.

label: People
description: People, teams and resource pools in the workforce.

label: Working weeks
description: Everyone's working weeks: the hours each person is available, from which date.

label: Assets
description: Equipment register, hierarchical twin, and engineering specifications.

label: Classifications
description: Engineering taxonomies and specification schemas for equipment classes.

label: Meters
description: Asset counters, run hours and operational gauges.

label: MRO Parts
description: Spare parts, inventory balances, and storeroom movements.

label: Requests
description: Intake, track and triage maintenance requests.

label: PM Schedules
description: Manage recurring maintenance schedules and trigger preventive work orders.

label: Spaces
description: Manage facility spaces, architectural hierarchy, and located assets.

label: Work orders
description: Raise, execute and complete maintenance work with evidence.

label: Screening criteria
description: The cited thresholds and ranges the screening engines apply.

label: Library
description: The cited reference data the screening engines read: materials, interaction rules, reaction classes and energetic groups.

label: Projects
description: Process development projects and the routes screened in them.

label: Routes
description: Synthetic routes, step by step, screened before kilo-lab.

label: Substances
description: The substances your routes use, with formulas and molar masses.

label: Attributes
description: The attributes products can carry.

label: Catalogue versions
description: Build a catalogue version, then submit, approve and publish it.

label: Catalogues
description: Catalogues and their versions.

label: Categories
description: The category tree products are filed under.

label: Price-list versions
description: Set prices in a version, then submit, approve and activate it.

label: Price lists
description: Price lists and their versions.

label: Products
description: Products, services and resources other modules use by reference.

label: Units
description: Units of measure and their conversions.

label: Balances
description: Stock on hand, reserved and available by location.

label: Cost layers
description: Append-only valuation layers mirrored from stock ledger debits.

label: Items
description: Products held in stock and how they are replenished and valued.

label: Stock ledger
description: Every posted stock movement. Reading entries needs inventory:ledger:read.

label: Lots
description: Lot and batch traceability.

label: Posted costs
description: Finance-posted receipt valuation received through the signed inbox.

label: Receipts
description: Receive goods into warehouse locations.

label: Reservations
description: Demand allocations by warehouse and locator.

label: Warehouse map
description: Locator grid with live quantities and lot expiry hints.

label: Warehouses
description: Warehouses and their storage locations.

label: Credit memos
description: Issue customer credit memos for returns and billing adjustments.

label: Customer invoices
description: Issue and review customer AR invoices against shipped order quantities.

label: Fulfillment orders
description: Create outbound fulfillment shipments against allocated sales order lines.

label: Sales orders
description: Create and review customer sales orders.

label: Sales quotes
description: Create and review customer sales quotations.

label: Debit memos
description: Issue vendor debit memos against bills or purchase orders.

label: Purchase orders
description: Create and review purchase order commitments to vendors.

label: Requisitions
description: Create and review internal purchase requisitions before PO conversion.

label: Vendor bills
description: Record vendor AP invoices for matching and approval.
